note: Physically he is a clean fit — 6'0" and 179 lb, training two or three times a week for three years, curling 45 lb one-handed, self-rating his physique 6/10 and asking for definition and arms rather than rescue. Health is genuinely the neglected corner: a newborn, four children and broken sleep have squeezed it. He fails the commercial half. His occupation was never established because it was never asked, so 'already successful — business owner, physician or equivalent' has no evidence behind it either way, and on income he priced the offer at $500 a month and framed $6,000 as a family sacrifice weighed against four children and a wife who is not invested. Worth noting for the rollup: this is the fourth prospect in this batch to fail on income and the third whose real objection was scope rather than affordability — he wanted to buy less, not to pay less.
